prompt.project_info: A bright studio fashion portrait with a glossy red inflatable chair and punchy retro-pop color blocking.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with fair skin and red hair in a high sleek bun with soft face-framing tendrils. She smiles playfully while holding a bright green lollipop, wearing a white ribbed short-sleeve graphic tee, high-waisted blue denim shorts, gold hoops, layered chains, and bracelets.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical seated portrait on a glossy translucent red inflatable chair against a simple neutral wall. The lollipop is near but not in the mouth; graphic apparel must be abstract and unreadable, with no logos or text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright directional studio softbox light at 5000K, soft shadow edge, tactile vinyl and denim surfaces, visible natural skin texture, vivid but controlled red-green-blue palette.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame camera with a 50mm lens at f/2.8, vertical 3:4 crop, realistic studio sharpness, subtle grain, natural highlight roll-off.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Vibrant retro-pop studio portrait of an adult red-haired woman in a high sleek bun with soft tendrils, seated on a glossy translucent red inflatable chair. She smiles playfully while holding a bright green lollipop near her face, wearing a white ribbed short-sleeve tee with an abstract unreadable color graphic, high-waisted blue denim shorts, gold hoop earrings, layered necklaces, and bracelets. Bright directional studio light, neutral background, tactile vinyl and denim, natural skin texture, vertical composition, no logos or readable text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed hands

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use optional adult identity and wardrobe references for continuity. Preserve the red bun, red inflatable chair, green lollipop, and high-waisted casual styling; identity, accessories, and abstract graphic may be replaced, but never render brands or text.
